## Post hoc: regret of alternative fixed policies (decision cells)

Not a preregistered statistic. Regret = median(policy's plan) / median(empirical best plan). The preregistered fixed policy (P7) is in the gates, not here.

### ALWAYS_MATERIALIZE (P5)

| regime | decision cells | median regret | p95 regret | max regret | share > 1.05 | share > 1.15 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| glibc_default_fresh | 65 | 1.339 | 7.992 | 9.306 | 0.95 | 0.92 |

### ALWAYS_REUSE, no fusion (P6)

| regime | decision cells | median regret | p95 regret | max regret | share > 1.05 | share > 1.15 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| glibc_default_fresh | 65 | 1.121 | 1.285 | 1.388 | 0.82 | 0.40 |
